set.body: Cross-reference ephys4s-provider-ravel-zero-oracle. Canonical9b53145 and d8019ce share raw NumPy reduction helper. PR2 CI38467424750 fails signed_zero_max on Linux NumPy2.4.3: Ravel +0, NumPy -0 for [0.,-0.]. Keep strict signed-zero checks and Ravel numerical contract. Explicitly adapt NumPy extrema to Ravel documented IEEE min/max zero policy independent of SIMD ordering; add both-order, axis, NaN and Float32/64 regression, run common-ops168 signatures plus authoritative release gate. No tolerance relaxation.
set.title: Normalize signed-zero NumPy extrema oracle across platforms
